The end of an era begins.

A new threat is rising. The Avengers are assembling once again. And at the center of it all stands Doctor Doom.

1B ALBUM: THE OTHER SIDE OF THE FACE is a 50-track journey into a side of IBRAAH the world has never fully experienced.
Built around love, heartbreak, ambition, real-life stories, street energy and celebration, 1B brings together different emotions and sounds while showing IBRAAH growth, versatility and evolution as an artist.
From the heart of Bongo Flava to fresh African sounds and unexpected musical flavours, every track carries its own story, mood and identity. The album also features powerful collaborations with Phina, Yammi, Young Lunya, Billnass, Mr Blue, D Voice, Chidy Benz, King Kaka, Dully Sykes, Paato, and other special guests, bringing different voices and energies into one world.
1B represents more than music. It is about revealing what exists beyond the face people already know — the emotions, experiences, struggles, love, confidence and different sides of IBRAAH.
50 tracks. Different stories. Different emotions. One artist.
This is the other side of the face. This is 1B.
